categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Modifies IPC fuzz testing harness and Cap'n Proto interface definitions under src/ipc/test/fuzz/.
categories.rationale: Expands the IPC fuzz target to validate bidirectional callbacks and error handling for malformed Cap'n Proto payloads across the process boundary. Hardening serialization and deserialization against corrupted data provides meaningful stability value for multiprocess, though as an incremental test expansion it remains reasonably deferrable.
